in_marathi.name: Hrishika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Hrishikesh's delight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrishika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the name Hrishikesh, meaning 'abode of Vishnu', Hrishika is a delightful and enchanting name for a girl. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is often referred to as Hrishikesh, the one who nourishes and protects. Hrishika embodies the grace and beauty of the divine feminine while invoking the nurturing and protective qualities of the deity.
